metadata.title: SSPP Template - Secure Identity Provider
metadata.remarks: Normative SSPP template defining identity assurance requirements for identity providers (IdPs). This template evaluates whether an identity provider can be trusted to correctly, continuously, and securely assert identity claims. It intentionally distinguishes provider assurance from the Secure Identity pattern definition.

import-profile.remarks: Imports institutional baseline security and assurance requirements.

system-characteristics.system-description: Identity assurance controls ensuring that identity providers maintain strong authentication, credential protection, session security, breach resistance, federation integrity, and auditable evidence over time and during failure conditions.

props.name: institutional-owner
props.remarks: Defines identity assurance posture, risk tolerance, and outcomes required for trusted identity providers.

props.name: service-owner
props.remarks: Responsible for implementation, operation, and maintenance of identity provider security controls.

props.name: governance-scope
props.remarks: This SSPP governs the assurance properties of identity providers. It does not define lifecycle provisioning, application authorization, or cloud platform trust.

system-implementation.remarks: This SSPP asserts identity provider assurance by referencing institutional identity patterns. Compliance requires satisfaction or documented compensation for all referenced patterns.

components.title: Secure Identity (Composite Assertion)
components.description: Composite assertion that identity claims issued by the provider meet institutional Secure Identity requirements.

links.text: Asserts the Secure Identity composite pattern

components.title: Identity Core
components.description: Authoritative identity definition, uniqueness, namespace control, and attribution.

components.title: Identity Authentication
components.description: Verification of identity claims including MFA enforcement, password policy, breached password protection, and resistance to credential compromise.

components.title: Identity Authorization
components.description: Assertion of access eligibility and privilege boundaries at the identity-provider layer.

components.title: Identity Lifecycle
components.description: Creation, modification, suspension, revocation, and destruction of identity records at the provider.
components.remarks: Provisioning source systems and DRP orchestration are evaluated in Identity Governance SSPPs.

components.title: Identity Federation
components.description: Trust relationships, assertion exchange, and assurance preservation across organizational identity boundaries.

components.title: Identity Assurance
components.description: Evaluation of confidence in identity claims including continuous risk analysis, anomaly detection, and compromise signaling.

components.title: Identity Logging and Audit
components.description: Generation, retention, and availability of identity-related logs for monitoring, investigation, and accountability.

components.title: Identity Privileged Access
components.description: Safeguards governing elevated and emergency identities, including break-glass accounts and separation of duties.

components.title: Non-Human Identity
components.description: Management and protection of service accounts, workload identities, and automation principals.

components.title: Identity Device Binding
components.description: Binding of identities to trusted devices, execution environments, or hardware-backed assurance contexts.

roles.title: Identity Assurance Authority
roles.remarks: Defines institutional identity assurance standards, acceptable authentication strength, and risk tolerance.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Executive Cyber Leadership per NIST NICE Framework (SP 800-181).

roles.title: Identity Security Operations
roles.remarks: Operates identity protection, detection, federation integrity monitoring, and response to compromise.

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Security Operations Analyst per NIST NICE Framework.

roles.title: Identity Control Assessor
roles.remarks: Performs identity provider assurance assessments and issues security assessment reports (SARs).

props.name: nice-work-role
props.remarks: Risk Management Specialist per NIST NICE Framework.

control-implementation.remarks: Identity provider assurance is demonstrated through enforced authentication controls, breached-password prevention, continuous identity risk monitoring, session misuse protection, federation integrity, privileged account safeguards, and auditable evidence. Failures impacting identity confidence may result in Red or Amber SAR findings.
